ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router for multi-agent systems that uses kNN over exemplar indices and LLM-judge writebacks to dynamically route incoming sub-tasks to the cheapest capable agent.
ideas.title: SelfHealRouter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven hard engineering patterns from successful past hackathons by implementing a self-improving feedback loop without requiring model retraining.

ideas.pitch: An agentic pre-deployment risk diagnosis tool that parses business workflow diagrams and uses coded agents to simulate adversarial inputs and flag compliance edge-cases before deployment.
ideas.title: BPMNGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a complex enterprise workflow constraint, matching the engineering depth and human-in-the-loop validation seen in winning governance agents.

ideas.pitch: A runtime optimization proxy that intercepts LLM reasoning traces, detects logical shortcut patterns using reinforcement learning rewards, and caches compressed steps to halve token overhead.
ideas.title: ReasonCache
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-utility infrastructure improvement, mirroring successful projects that make complex model reasoning significantly faster and cheaper.

ideas.pitch: A dual-agent simulation environment where two autonomous agents negotiate a shared task while continuously monitored for emergent deceptive behavior and sudden strategy shifts.
ideas.title: AdversarialArena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases complex multi-agent dynamics and unscripted autonomous behavior that instantly captivates live judges during a product demonstration.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first AI code review agent optimized to run locally on hardware neural processing units, performing continuous static analysis and vulnerability patching without cloud latency.
ideas.title: EdgeReviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers practical, privacy-first local AI deployment that directly appeals to judges looking for real-world utility beyond standard cloud-dependent wrappers.
